But we should check if there's any more recent info. It's currently 2026-10-19. So it's possible that there has been an election or change. In California, gubernatorial elections happen every four years, with the last one in 2022. The next would be 2026. If the user is asking now in October 2026, maybe the election hasn't happened yet or just happened. Let's consider: California's gubernatorial term is four years, starting in January after the election. The last election was November 2022, so the term started in January 2023. Next election would be November 2026, term starts January 2027. So as of October 2026, the governor is still Gavin Newsom until the inauguration. So answer: Gavin Newsom.
